description.translate: Bring sixteen basalt for the signal tower and its braces. We need a landmark a returning party can recognise through the ash. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

He came to capture the Inferno's power. He believed the abilities he had already gathered would carry him through another battle. When that confidence failed, he stayed to cover our retreat. I remember his courage, and I remember that he chose to bring us there before we were ready.
